title: f120.6: relay metrics — per-peer Prometheus counters in smtp/metrics.rs
description:
Add per-peer Prometheus metrics for relay health to crates/smtp/src/metrics.rs.

**What:** Add relay_attempts_total, relay_successes_total, relay_failures_total, relay_peer_up gauges with peer label.

**Algorithm:**
1. Read crates/smtp/src/metrics.rs to understand the existing Prometheus registration pattern
2. Add metrics family:
   - Counter relay_attempts_total {peer: String}
   - Counter relay_successes_total {peer: String}
   - Counter relay_failures_total {peer: String, kind: 'transient'|'permanent'}
   - Gauge relay_peer_up {peer: String} — 1.0 if up, 0.0 if down
3. Add fn inc_relay_attempt(peer: &str), fn inc_relay_success(peer: &str), fn inc_relay_failure(peer: &str, kind: &str), fn set_relay_peer_up(peer: &str, up: bool) matching existing metrics module patterns
4. Wire into relay_queue.rs: call metrics fns after each delivery attempt result

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Peer label must not include credentials or port (use host only)
- Never expose counter for password attempts (no 'auth_attempt' counter that could leak timing)
- Metrics registration must be idempotent (registration errors must not crash)

**Tests:**
- Test: inc_relay_success('peer1') increments the counter — assert relay_successes_total{peer='peer1'} == 1 (oracle: prometheus registry query)
- Test: set_relay_peer_up('peer1', false) sets gauge to 0.0

**Acceptance:**
- cargo test -p usenet-ipfs-smtp passes
- cargo clippy -p usenet-ipfs-smtp -- -D warnings passes
